description: This Java class implements an InputStream backed by a ByteBuffer, providing efficient read operations from Buffer instances, including an optimization for ByteBuffers with array backing.

classes.name: ByteBufferInputStream
classes.description: A final class extending InputStream, providing an implementation that reads data from a ByteBuffer, with an optimization for backing arrays.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method that creates an InputStream from a ByteBuffer, utilizing ByteArrayInputStream if the buffer has an accessible array, otherwise wrapping it in ByteBufferInputStream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Overrides InputStream.read() to read one byte from the ByteBuffer, returning -1 if no remaining data.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Overrides InputStream.read(byte[], int, int) to read multiple bytes into an array, optimizing for remaining data and buffer capacity.
